newsitem.title: JAPAN: Marubeni acquires U.S. auto dealer for $50 mln.
newsitem.headline: Marubeni acquires U.S. auto dealer for $50 mln.

text.p: Marubeni Corp said on Monday it acquired U.S. auto dealer Lazarus Auto Group Inc for $50 million in late May.
The purchase was made through the trading company's wholly owned U.S. subsidiary in Los Angeles, Marubeni Motor Service Inc, a Marubeni spokesman said.
Lazarus is based in Long Island and handles U.S. and European cars, Marubeni said. It posted sales of $185 million in calendar 1996, it said.

"Until now we have exported Japanese cars, but recently, carmakers themselves started to export their own products. We now have to act as importers and dealers to be able to keep up with changes in business," the spokesman said.
Marubeni said it would invest more than one billion yen over the next three years to establish six new outlets in Long Island.
